headline: Attackers are weaponizing fresh disclosures within hours, driving active exploitation of critical SharePoint, ServiceNow, and WordPress flaws faster than defenders can patch.

emerging_trends.text: The window between a patch and a working exploit keeps shrinking, with attackers weaponizing SharePoint, ServiceNow, and WordPress flaws within days of a public proof-of-concept.
emerging_trends.topic_title: Enterprise RCE Flaws Exploited Within Days

emerging_trends.text: Attackers increasingly aim at the AI stack itself, as ENCFORGE ransomware encrypts model weights and vector databases and thousands of fake GitHub repositories pose as AI Skills and MCP servers to poison the agents that recommend code.
emerging_trends.topic_title: ENCFORGE Ransomware Targets AI Model Files

emerging_trends.text: Espionage crews keep hiding their command channels inside trusted cloud services, abusing Microsoft 365 and Outlook calendars and even DNS AAAA records so their traffic blends into ordinary enterprise noise.
emerging_trends.topic_title: Calendar-Abusing Espionage Malware CAV3RN and HollowGraph

topics.title: Enterprise RCE Flaws Exploited Within Days
topics.latest_developments: watchTowr caught attackers exploiting SharePoint deserialization flaw CVE-2026-50522, the third July SharePoint bug to go live after a public proof-of-concept, and Defused Cyber spotted in-the-wild exploitation of ServiceNow AI Platform sandbox-escape CVE-2026-6875.
topics.summary: Both flaws let an unauthenticated attacker run code over the network—CVE-2026-50522 rates 9.8 and CVE-2026-6875 rates 9.5. Microsoft patched SharePoint in its July Patch Tuesday and credited DEVCORE, and ServiceNow shipped its fix days before the attacks began. Patch both now.

Exploitation of ServiceNow Vulnerability Seen Days After Disclosure

topics.title: CISA Adds WordPress, Langflow, and DD-WRT Flaws to KEV
topics.latest_developments: CISA added four actively exploited flaws to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on July 21—WordPress core bugs CVE-2026-60137 and CVE-2026-63030 that together form the wp2shell chain, Langflow flaw CVE-2026-0770, and DD-WRT stack overflow CVE-2021-27137—as wp2shell scanning and successful compromises spread within three days of disclosure.
topics.summary: wp2shell chains a WordPress-core SQL injection with an interpretation-conflict bug to reach unauthenticated remote code execution, and WordPress pushed 6.9.5 and 7.0.2 through auto-update. Federal agencies face a KEV patch deadline, and every site owner should update immediately.

sources.title: CISA Adds Four Known Exploited Vulnerabilities to Catalog

topics.title: ENCFORGE Ransomware Targets AI Model Files
topics.latest_developments: Sysdig tied a second attack on the same Langflow server to JadePuffer, the AI-agent-driven extortion operator, which now deploys ENCFORGE, a compiled Go ransomware that encrypts model weights, vector indexes, training datasets, and model checkpoints across the host.
topics.summary: JadePuffer runs its extortion end-to-end through an autonomous AI agent, and the same extortion contact ties both campaigns; ENCFORGE is the first ransomware aimed squarely at AI and machine-learning infrastructure. The operators entered through a Langflow remote-code-execution flaw.

sources.title: New ENCFORGE Ransomware Targets AI Model Files in Langflow RCE Attack
JadePuffer agentic attacks now target AI model data with ransomware
JadePuffer returns with ransomware built to target AI models and infrastructure

topics.title: Calendar-Abusing Espionage Malware CAV3RN and HollowGraph
topics.latest_developments: Kaspersky's GReAT team detailed a new Project CAV3RN module that drives command-and-control through a compromised Outlook calendar over Microsoft Graph and falls back to DNS AAAA responses to recover its configuration, while researchers separately traced HollowGraph turning a hijacked Microsoft 365 calendar into a two-way dead-drop.
topics.summary: Both families bury their command traffic inside legitimate Microsoft cloud services to support long-term espionage, and investigators have linked the calendar-hijacking activity to Iranian operations. Hunt for anomalous Graph API and calendar activity on compromised mailboxes.

sources.title: New Project CAV3RN module abuses Outlook calendar events for C2 and DNS AAAA records for configuration recovery
New HollowGraph Malware Abuses Microsoft 365 Calendar for C&C Communication
New HollowGraph malware uses Microsoft Graph for stealthy C2 comms

topics.title: FakeGit Floods GitHub With 7,600 Malicious Repos
topics.latest_developments: Island uncovered FakeGit, roughly 7,600 malicious GitHub repositories—more than 800 posing as AI Skills or Model Context Protocol servers—tied to about 6,600 accounts and built to feed SmartLoader malware to developers and to the AI agents that recommend code.
topics.summary: The repos copy real projects with lookalike developer profiles and convincing READMEs, ranging from Gmail and WhatsApp integrations to AI workflows, and deliver SmartLoader through malicious ZIP files; the wave peaked in April 2026. Verify a repository's provenance before cloning it or trusting an agent's suggestion.

sources.title: AI agents tricked into recommending malicious GitHub repositories
FakeGit Campaign Uses 7,600 GitHub Repositories to Spread SmartLoader Malware

topics.title: Kenyan President's Website Hacked for Bitcoin Ransom
topics.latest_developments: Kenya opened an investigation after attackers hijacked President William Ruto's official website on Saturday, July 18, swapping its homepage for a cryptocurrency wallet address and a threat to publish unspecified information about Ruto unless he paid.
topics.summary: The attackers left an extortion demand and a bitcoin wallet address, and no group has claimed the hack. Kenyan authorities are probing how the intruders reached the site.

sources.title: Kenya probes hack of president's website after bitcoin ransom demand
